- claim-4: Under the accepted quotient-conjugation and ideal-correspondence premises, partition conjugation induces an integral graded isomorphism \[ J_v/A_+J_v\cong J_{v^\vee}/A^\vee_+J_{v^\vee}. \] Consequently it preserves each degree’s torsion subgroup, invariant factors, and free rank.
## Strategy
Let \(A=\Lambda/I_{r,q}\), \(A^\vee=\Lambda/I_{q,r}\), \(q=n-r\). Accepted quotient conjugation gives the integral ring isomorphism
\[
\Omega:A\to A^\vee,\qquad \bar s_\lambda\mapsto\bar s_{\lambda'}.
\]
Since \(|\lambda'|=|\lambda|\), \(\Omega\) preserves partition-weight grading. Accepted ideal correspondence gives \(\Omega(J_v)=J_{v^\vee}\). Hence
\[
\Omega(A_+)=A^\vee_+,\qquad
\Omega(A_+J_v)=A^\vee_+J_{v^\vee},
\]
degreewise. Thus \(\Omega\) descends to an integral graded isomorphism
\[
J_v/A_+J_v\;\xrightarrow{\sim}\;J_{v^\vee}/A^\vee_+J_{v^\vee}.
\]
Therefore, in every degree, torsion subgroups, invariant factors, and free \(\mathbb Z\)-ranks agree. Here the right-hand \(A_+\) means \(A^\vee_+\).

The accepted child repair `research-attempt-research-plan-task-264-1` additionally records a non-self-conjugate quotient-level Smith-form check in weights \(6,\dots,20\); it is a bounded verification only, not the universal proof.

The requested standalone corollary is established.
